stem.text: In an experiment, $2.00\ \text{mol}$ of hydrogen and $3.00\ \text{mol}$ of iodine were heated together in a sealed container and allowed to reach equilibrium at a fixed temperature. The container had a fixed volume of $1.00\ \text{dm}^3$. At equilibrium, there were $2.40\ \text{mol}$ of iodine present in the mixture.
What is the value of the equilibrium constant, $K_\text{c}$?
